title: Home Purchase Financing — Issuing a Payoff Statement
content:
**Payoff desk reference — the payoff statement on a Home Purchase Financing loan**

## What a statement is

A payoff statement is issued on request on a loan that is active or delinquent; it states the good-through date and the payoff amount, the amount that pays the loan in full when received on or before that date.

## Fixing the payoff figure

The payoff figure is fixed only after the fees owed on the loan carry the late charge due on every installment that was not paid in full within its grace period.

This is a condition on the fees owed as the loan's records show them when the statement is issued.

## The system action: `issue_payoff_statement_6569642c`

**Capability.** Issues a payoff statement on a Hearthstone Home Finance loan, dated today. It records one payoff statement on the loan stating the amount that pays the loan in full and the last day that figure is good; the statement then appears among the loan's notices and can be given to the borrower or the closing agent. Balances on the loan are not changed.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `issue_payoff_statement_6569642c` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `loan_id` | the loan number of the Hearthstone Home Finance loan, as returned by the loan lookup for the verified borrower | identifier |
| `good_through_date` | the last day the payoff figure is good | YYYY-MM-DD, a calendar date with no time of day |
| `payoff_amount` | the amount that pays the loan in full on or before the good-through date | USD with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** On success: `status` "issued", `loan_notice_id` (reference of the payoff statement), `loan_id`, `notice_date` (today, YYYY-MM-DD), `good_through_date` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `payoff_amount` (USD, 2 decimal places).
